claims.statement: Management expects general merchandise and apparel (GMA) to trend around the current run rate of about 23%.
claims.quote: A broad trend line will be around the current run rates of around 23%, is the sense we get.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management targets opening around 40-50 stores per year currently, with aspirations to scale up to 60 or 70 stores per year in another two to three years.
claims.quote: We are primed and ready in terms of opening around 40-50 stores. I mean anything between that is what we are ready and we will deliver broadly... in another two to three years, this 40 should go to a 60 or a 70 per year.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that new store openings should typically account for 10% to 15% of the total store count.
claims.quote: I've been saying this repeatedly that typically 10% to 15% of my number count should be my new store opening, broadly.
claims.speaker: management

facts.statement: The total retail business area at the end of fiscal 2024 was about 15.1 million square feet, with 1.8 million square feet added during the current year.
facts.quote: The total retail business area at the end of the fiscal '24 was about 15.1 million square feet. We opened 1.8 million square feet area in the current year.

facts.statement: Standalone revenue from operations for fiscal 2024 was INR49,533 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 8.3% and a PAT of INR2,695 crores.
facts.quote: The revenue from operations as disclosed earlier is INR49,533 crores, delivered in the stand-alone business. EBITDA margin of 8.3%, so almost INR4,100 crores of EBITDA. We delivered 5.4% PAT, about INR2,695 crores.

facts.statement: The company reported net cash flow from operations of INR3,343 crores for fiscal 2024.
facts.quote: And the net cash flow from operations of INR3,343 crores.

facts.statement: Total equity stands at approximately INR19,281 crores, and debt on the balance sheet relates primarily to Ind AS 116 disclosures.
facts.quote: Debt and equity, we all know we don't have debt, but the debt that you see on the balance sheet is about the Ind AS 116 disclosure and the equity is about INR19,281 crores.

facts.statement: Avenue E-commerce reported a 31.7% sales increase to close to INR2,900 crores with a loss of INR185 crores.
facts.quote: Avenue E-commerce delivered a 31.7% sales increase, close to INR2,900 crores and we had a loss of INR185 crores, which was a 240 bps loss reduction over the prior year.
